thread:
maria: Heads-up — RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight gateway shim to handle /v1/embeddings -> /v2/embeddings translation so we can start deprecating v1 without breaking customers. TL;DR: param rename + framing compatibility, opt-in header for strict mode.
jordan: high-level sounds fine. couple questions: how intrusive is the transform? will it change payload sizes or latency noticeably?
maria: transform is minimal: rename `dim` -> `embedding_dim`, passthrough of `model` names with a small compatibility map, and streaming frame mapper for older clients. should be <1ms p50 extra.
sam: streaming frame mapper deserves its own note. older clients use the legacy newline-delimited frames we adopted in 2022; runtime needs to unwrap and reframe to the new chunked SSE-like stream. this adds CPU per-connection but we can offload to gateway sidecar.
li: sidecar sounds safer. if we do it in the edge gateway we can route opt-in tenants to sidecar pool. also need to ensure TLS client certs / auth header passthrough stays intact.
anya: ML note — the embedding vector shape is the same except the `dim` key name. but watch out for model aliases: some customers call `text-sim-v1` which maps to `text-sim-2025` on v2. need alias map and test vectors to validate parity.
pat: product asks — what should we tell customers? We'd like to announce "v1 deprecated in 90 days, shim available for 6mo" or similar. also need a migration guide snippet.
maria: draft rollout plan: 1) land alias map + shim behind flag (2 weeks). 2) enable opt-in header `X-Compat: v1-embeddings` for early customers (2 weeks). 3) telemetry + error spikes watch (2 weeks). 4) set default enabled for all tenants (60 days). 5) deprecation notice + final removal 6 months after default on.
jordan: telemetry detail: we need event surface for "shim-applied" + failure buckets: param-missing, alias-unknown, framing-error. add counter and sample traces.
li: infra checklist: sidecar autoscale policy, route table entries, canary 1%/10%/50%, circuit breaker if CPU > 80% for 5m. also add a debug endpoint to replay raw payloads.
sam: runtime checklist: implement streaming-framing shim in sidecar (node or rust?), prefer Rust for perf and mem safety. provide a small JS package for local dev that simulates legacy frames.
anya: will prepare a 20-sample eval set (expected embeddings + cosine differences) and a regression alert threshold. share via google drive link when ready.
pat: comms + docs action: prepare migration doc + sample curl, and standard deprecation email copy. keep timeline conservative.
maria: quick example transform (gateway shim):
```
// incoming v1
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "text-sim-v1", "dim": 1536, "input": "..." }
\n// shim -> v2
POST /v2/embeddings
{ "model": "text-sim-2025", "embedding_dim": 1536, "input": "..." }
```
li: looks good. small nit: include `X-Deprecated-Version: v1` header on responses so downstream proxying tools can log it.
jordan: plus add a sample rate-limited warning header so clients don't get spammed: `Deprecation-Warning: v1 will be removed in 90d; sample=0.01`.
maria: agreed. ops note: default behavior for tenants with known incompatibilities is to keep shim enabled even after default flip for +30d, but mark in tenant metadata as "legacy_enabled":true and emit an org-level deprecation report.
sam: one more runtime concern — KV cache keys: v1 used a slightly different prefix for prefix-caching. shim must normalize cache keys to v2 scheme to avoid duplicate cache entries.
anya: confirm cache-normalization in tests; if we miss that we'll double cache and harm perf.
pat: timeline sync — I'll take the comms and coordinate support playbook. can the eng team commit to the 2-week flag phase?
maria: yes. I'll draft the RFC addendum and attach the alias map. will ping infra for canary slots.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview: sidecar/shim-service @ canary cluster created (id: canary-emb-shim-42) :rocket:
pat: awesome, thanks. next steps: docs + customer list for opt-in.
maria: thanks all. i'll open follow-up tasks and mark owners. :thumbsup:
